title: Steps to manage  term deposit monthly interest

steps.text: Login to mobile application,Land on deposits dashboard
Select  “Term Deposit Monthly Interest” type , Click on 'manage deposit' button
Select the interest payout account ,the payout after maturity account.
Manage auto renewal (On / Off). If turned on,'Renew principal amount only' by default is available then Confirm the 'Terms and conditions' and Click 'Save'
